headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Over 500 Points Ahead of RBI Monetary Policy Decision

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Anticipation of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting outcome
Strong performance in the banking and metal sectors
Positive global market cues and rebound in early trade
Cabinet approval of a Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund
whatHappening: Sensex rose over 500 points, with Nifty 50 holding the 22,700 level
Reliance Industries and banking stocks saw significant gains during the session
Swara Baby Products received SEBI approval for a Rs 1,000 crore IPO
The IT sector lagged behind the broader market rally
summary: The Indian stock market rallied on October 6, 2026, as investors positioned themselves ahead of the RBI's monetary policy announcement. Gains were led by the banking and metal sectors, along with Reliance Industries, while the IT sector remained under pressure. Significant news included SEBI's nod for the Swara Baby Products IPO and Cabinet approval for an SME growth fund.
